script:
[0:00-0:03] HOOK  
"Your AI chatbot might be listening to you even when you’re not typing!"

[0:03-0:08] CONTEXT  
"AI chatbots are everywhere—from customer service to personal assistants. We type questions, expecting privacy, but what if these bots hear more than you think?"

[0:08-0:18] EVIDENCE  
"Recent investigations revealed some AI apps access microphones without explicit permission. In 2023, a major chatbot app was caught recording audio snippets to improve responses, often without clear user consent."

[0:18-0:28] TENSION  
"What no one talks about is how this data is stored and who really controls it. Private conversations could be analyzed by third parties or used to target ads, blurring the line between help and invasion."

[0:28-0:35] PAYOFF  
"The shocking truth? You might be giving away more than just typed words—your voice, your environment, your secrets. Stay aware and check app permissions now."

[0:35-0:42] CTA  
"Follow for more tech exposes! Have you ever suspected your AI was listening? Drop your story in the comments!"
